programme.title: E1 - A Super Fun Day on the Farm!
programme.desc: Join Ella for a super fun day at Lellobee City Farm! First, when a nest of baby duck eggs starts to hatch, Ella has to play 'Mummy Duck' to keep all the cute but runaway ducklings together! Then, Rishi organizes all the animals for a friendly game of soccer, where everyone learns each other's animal sounds. The fun day ends with a new arrival, as Ella & Mei find & adopt a stray cat named Bingo, welcoming him to his new home!

programme.title: E1 - Battling Evil Robots & Racing Villains!
programme.desc: Get ready for an action-packed day of battling evil robots & racing villains! First, the new & improved Robofreeze becomes faulty, & Mila & Morphle must help Officer Freeze retrieve the remote to turn him off! Then, it's time for the Pet Port Rally, but naughty Winston cheats by using sneaky devices to slow everyone down. The chaos continues as two Robofreezes turn evil & multiply, & a lightning strike turns another one into a super-powered menace!

programme.title: E4 - JJ's August Art Explorers
programme.desc: It's an Artsy August crafting adventure! Help JJ, Kiki, and Emmy make a hot air balloon to chase Boba's lost balloon. Then, unlock a pirate treasure chest, have a dance party on a disco mat, and bake some delicious alphabet cupcakes!

programme.title: E3 - Mia & The Bus's Art Day
programme.desc: Get arty with Little Baby Bum this August! Help Mia and her friends paint a huge mural of The Bus. Then, bake yummy muffins with Rose, play BINGO with the whole family, and have a dino-tastic snack time in a pretend Dinosaur Cafe!

programme.title: E3 - Races, Games & Helping Friends!
programme.desc: Join the crew for some fun competitions & a day of helping friends! First, the friends compete in a fun obstacle course to see who can finish the race the fastest & lift the special trophy! Then, just as the crew is ready to demolish an old building, a cute cat hops inside, & the team must rescue the kitten before finishing the job. The helping continues as they save another kitten from a dangerous situation & Dazey must think fast to save Mrs. Skip from a runaway river barge!

programme.title: E9 - Jill & Baby John's Artsy Bake-Off
programme.desc: It's an Artsy August bake-off! Join a team and see who can create the best cake for the judge, Bingo! Then, become a powerful luchador superhero and have fun playing all the different games at the family carnival.

programme.title: E4 - Fun Facts About The World!
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He & D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors & why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert & helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: E1 - From Dinosaurs To Pet Knights!
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak & pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags & even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor—who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: E2 - A Day of Cody's Favorite Things!
programme.desc: Join Cody for a day filled with all his favorite things! First, Cody gets to live out his dino dreams as he dons a dinosaur costume & pretends to be a monster attacking a toy bridge. The fun continues at school, where he starts playing a guitar & his classmates join in to form their very own rock band! Cody also shows his caring side as he & his friends encounter a lost baby duckling & lead the way to help it find the perfect home.

programme.title: E1 - When Arpo's Imagination Runs Wild!
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The fantasy continues when Arpo accidentally creates a giant, sentient jelly monster that takes over the entire house & needs to be stopped!

programme.title: E6 - Mila & Chroma's August Splat-tacular
programme.desc: Get set for an Artsy August adventure! Race with Mila and Morphle in a hot air balloon against tricky racers. Then, help them find a cure for a sneezing Chroma who is covering the city in paint, and join a wild, musical talent show chase!

programme.title: E1 - A Day in the Life of JJ & Friends!
programme.desc: Spend a fun-filled day in the life of JJ & his friends! First, Ms. Appleberry takes the Melon Patch kids on a beach field trip to learn about different types of vehicles. Then, JJ gets to bring a special guest to class: his dog, Bingo! Everyone has a great time as Bingo plays, snacks & even saves the day! The adventure continues at the farm, where JJ & Grandpa have to wrangle all the baby animals after they escape from their pen!

programme.desc: It's a day of learning to play together with blocks, dancing, football & storytime! The lessons continue as Bubbles learns not to cheat to win a football game & Jeff has to decide if he will share his new book during storytime.

programme.title: E6 - 潑水節全員濕身混戰團魂拉滿
programme.desc: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅。

programme.title: E30
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生。

programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識。

Fist Of Stardom
programme.desc: Thongpoon wants to produce a movie by using his gift of martial art to be a leading actor. Without money, he joins a boxing gambling for finding funds, but at last he becomes a prizefighter unexpectedly.

programme.title: Book of Love
programme.desc: Jiao Ye moved to Macau with her father when she was 15. She is a sassy casino worker who longs for love, but her life was hard. Daniel, a commitment-averse real estate agent in Los Angeles who specializes in selling properties to wealthy Chinese and father of a teenage son. Love blooms between the two as they start exchanging letters because of a book, they sharing their most personal and intimate self with each other.

programme.title: i'm livin' it
programme.desc: Once a star in his finance firm, Bowen now spends his nights in a 24-hour fast food joint, where he encounters others “roommates” who are in a similar predicament: a mother with her daughter who has taken out high-interest loans to cover her mother-in-law's debt, an old man who is too afraid to go home, a young runaway, a young singer living in a temporary shelter. Together these accidental roommates must strive to lift one another out of rock bottom.

programme.title: E47
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Round Playlist
programme.desc: The program is intended to promote exchanges between Korea and ASEAN countries by utilizing popular music.

programme.title: E20
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.desc: The true classic of the century is born again! The legendary classic is reinterpreted by the best vocalists in Korea. Don't miss out on the heart-moving moments that transcend generations.
